lines: He says “let’s hang” and then backs out at the last second.
She clears her schedule, waiting for him to show up.
He drops a meme instead of saying sorry.
She forces a laugh, but the hurt stays.
He does the same thing every month.
His fear makes him disappear when things get real.
People claim they’re busy to keep distance.
You aren’t an option you can toss aside.
You deserve someone who shows up, not ghosts.
Follow for more daily videos that help you understand people.
cta: Follow for more daily videos that help you understand people.
caption: Don’t let “busy” become your excuse for being ignored. Share if you agree.
